title: The Golden Lovers reunite
summary: Conflict inside Bullet Club brings Kenny Omega and Kota Ibushi back together. Their renewed partnership forces the Young Bucks to confront where they stand in Omega’s life and career.

chapters.title: Ibushi saves Omega
chapters.result: Ibushi stops Cody’s attack and embraces Omega.
chapters.context: The reunion restores the Golden Lovers after years apart and places their bond at the center of Bullet Club’s internal conflict.

chapters.title: The reunion faces the Young Bucks
chapters.result: The Golden Lovers defeat the Young Bucks.
chapters.context: The emotional tag-team main event tests divided loyalties as Omega wrestles his close friends alongside his reunited partner.
